en.headline: Bad & Breakfast greasy-spoon cafe to open on Wing Lok Street in Sheung Wan
en.dek: The outlet, a sequel to a Yau Ma Tei bar, will serve full English breakfast sets from HK$58 and cocktails at night starting this week.
body: A new cafe offering full English breakfasts and evening cocktails is due to open this week on Wing Lok Street in Sheung Wan.
Bad & Breakfast will occupy the ground floor of 186 Wing Lok Street, near traditional dried-seafood shops. It is a sequel to Bad Coffee & Liquor Club in Yau Ma Tei.

Breakfast sets are priced from HK$58 to HK$138 and include baked beans, fried eggs, gammon, black pudding, toast and mushrooms. At night the menu will feature cocktails from the Yau Ma Tei bar plus some Sheung Wan-only drinks.

Co-founder Linus said the team plans to incorporate local dried-seafood ingredients into both breakfast dishes and cocktails, describing it as a deeper attempt to blend Hong Kong elements into the concept.
The organisers said the venue aims to fill a gap for traditional British-style breakfasts in the district.

zh.headline: 上環永樂街將開英式早餐咖啡店Bad & Breakfast
zh.dek: 油麻地酒吧延續項目本周開業，全日英式早餐套餐由58元起，晚間供應雞尾酒。
body: 一間主打全日英式早餐及晚間雞尾酒的新咖啡店，本周將於上環永樂街開業。
Bad & Breakfast位於永樂街186號地下，鄰近傳統海味店。它是油麻地Bad Coffee & Liquor Club的延續項目。
早餐套餐售價由58元至138元，包括焙豆、煎蛋、火腿、黑布丁、多士及蘑菇。晚間會供應油麻地酒吧的雞尾酒，以及部分上環限定飲品。
聯合創辦人Linus表示，團隊計劃將本地海味食材融入早餐及雞尾酒，形容是更深層次地將香港元素融入概念。
負責人指，店舖希望填補區內傳統英式早餐的選擇。
